scope: Git exact-byte preservation and explicit historical source aliases after completed engineering and research. No numerical code, scientific receipt, original bundle, result or selection was rewritten; no experiment was replayed.

git_attributes.change: Four narrow -text -whitespace rules retain existing CRLF evidence bytes. Git clean-filter comparison proved those bytes would otherwise normalize to LF.

V19_execution_source_alias.mapping: Append each original repository-relative source path to base. Every copied member was checked against its original raw byte count and SHA256 before changing .gitattributes.
V19_execution_source_alias.limit: The historical runner still expects original live paths. Reproduction or a later continuation must explicitly resolve preserved aliases; this maintenance record does not authorize execution. The separately verified V19 source-delivery bundle remains unchanged.

later_shared_guidance.meaning: The retained MTF/RPB delivery receipts bind their dated bundle snapshots. Later authorized research-continuation prose in these two working-tree guides has a new source identity; it is not substituted for the delivered bytes.
later_shared_guidance.mapping: Original guide bytes remain at each historical bundle/sources/<original-path>.
later_shared_guidance.RPB_build_context: The RPB engineering receipt also retains its earlier root Makefile identity. Later V19 build integration is a separate source identity; its original imported numerical/build proof stays bound to the preserved delivery mapping.

publication: Commit source, contracts, evidence metadata and the maintained dashboard. Ignored datasets, checkpoints, optimizer state, source bundles and execution capsules remain local. No credentials or raw research artifacts are added to Git.
